revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the finance partner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. The cutting room now treats the 2-meter roll as a wide-roll setup. Every used cutting layout on a standard roll of at least 2 meters carries an additional 80 square meters of edge-trim allowance, on top of the existing pattern setup burden. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
